hero.p1: Your small groups are where much of your church’s ministry happens—but keeping track of dozens of groups shouldn’t require chasing down messages, spreadsheets, and reports.
hero.p2: ekklesiaio makes small-group reporting simple for leaders and actionable for church leadership.
hero.noSpam: No spam. One email when we launch.

problem.title: You have the groups. But do you know what’s happening in them?
problem.intro: You may have 20, 50, or 100 small groups meeting throughout your church.
problem.bLead: But getting that information back to church leadership can be difficult.
bItems: Pastors have to chase people down.
Information gets buried in messages and spreadsheets.
And even when reports arrive, reviewing them all takes time.

how.title: Simple for leaders. Powerful for church leadership.

steps.title: Leaders report
steps.body: Small-group leaders receive reminders and submit their reports through a simple workflow.

steps.title: Leadership reviews
steps.body: Pastors, elders, and administrators get a centralized view of what’s happening across their groups.

steps.title: Needs become visible
steps.body: Prayer requests, concerns, follow-ups, and other important information are easier to identify.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Keep track of what needs attention so important conversations don’t get lost.

features.title: Core features
features.f1b: Manage your groups and members from one place. Add, remove, and organize groups as your church changes.
features.f2b: Make it easy for small-group leaders to submit their reports without adding another administrative burden.
features.f3b: Help leaders remember to submit their reports without pastors having to chase them down.
features.f4b: Keep the right people informed when reports, requests, or other important updates need attention.
features.f5b: Turn information from your groups into actionable follow-ups so needs don’t get lost.
features.f6b: See what’s happening across your small groups and get a clearer picture of the life of your church.

ai.intro: ekklesiaio uses AI to help pastors and administrators make sense of every small-group report—so the people behind them get the attention they need.
ai.i1b: Get the key points of each report—and of the whole week across your groups—in a few sentences.
ai.i2b: See whether a group’s reports sound encouraged, steady, or in need of care—and notice when that changes.
ai.i3b: Surface the reports, requests, and changes that may need a pastor’s attention, so nothing important gets buried.
ai.i4b: Turn what leaders share into suggested prayer requests, ready for your team to review, edit, and share.
ai.t1b: Use the AI suggestions you find helpful and ignore the rest—or turn them off entirely. ekklesiaio works just as well without them.
ai.t2b: AI only suggests. Nothing is shared or acted on until a person has reviewed it.
ai.t3b: Your church’s reports are never used to train AI models.

card.title: Weekly insights
card.summary: Most groups met as planned. Two groups mentioned members facing job loss, and attendance at Riverside Families has dipped for three weeks.
card.attention: Riverside Families: attendance down three weeks in a row.
card.prayer: “Pray for the families in our church facing job loss—for provision, peace, and community around them.”
card.caption: Optional AI suggestion · review before sharing

philosophy.p1: ekklesiaio is built to reduce the administrative work around small-group ministry—not add more of it.
philosophy.p2: When leaders spend less time chasing reports, they can spend more time caring for people, building community, and making disciples.
philosophy.mission: To help churches care for people and make disciples by giving leaders better visibility into the life of their church.
philosophy.vision: A future where every church can easily understand, support, and care for the people in its community.
